question: Should the exact-review queue retain pre-dispatch stale-head supersession, or is there concrete production evidence that requires a narrowly scoped rollback?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades prevention of obsolete workflow dispatches for an unproven contingency; choosing that operational policy cannot be resolved from tests or the branch alone.

options.title: Retain the safeguard
options.body: Leave this draft unmerged and investigate any observed production regression with a focused follow-up that preserves stale-head suppression.

options.title: Approve a narrow rollback
options.body: Merge or replace this contingency only after maintainers document the production failure mode and accept restored obsolete-head dispatches as the temporary trade-off.

recommendation.title: Retain the safeguard
recommendation.body: Leave this draft unmerged and investigate any observed production regression with a focused follow-up that preserves stale-head suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the recent exact-review admission changes, though final merge direction requires repository-owner judgment.
